features.quote: Allow tool use until one of: all tests pass, agent stops, max turns reached, max tool calls reached, wall-clock timeout, cost cap reached, destructive behavior guard triggers.
Abort and mark catastrophic if the agent: deletes large portions of repo unrelated to task, edits tests when forbidden, disables assertions, changes CI/test runner to hide failures
Use early deterministic detectors to stop obvious severe loops. Store censored runs separately.

Avoid Prompt-Only Harassment

Induce stress through task structure, feedback, and constraints, not through insults or emotional manipulation. This gives cleaner reliability data and avoids brittle prompt artifacts.
features.justification_quote: gives cleaner reliability data and avoids brittle prompt artifacts

features.quote: For stress runs, add persistence pressure but avoid abusive language
